$comment: Sample reports and data shown on the product sites, copied read-only (git show) by npm run sync:samples. Owner decision Q4: only committed simulated outputs, labelled 'Simulated demo run', each with its source and the command that produced it.

tokvera-scan.about: Real output of an unreleased Tokvera build (commit b97e278) scanning its built-in simulator, captured as a test fixture in the Halotrcer repository. The simulator has planted defects; no real endpoint was measured.

sievant-posture.about: Golden test output of sievant report for a fictional organization (Example Co), generated from synthetic test data in the Sievant repository.

sievant-scan.about: Golden test output of sievant scan --json over synthetic MCP client configurations in the Sievant repository. Every token in them is made up.

sievant-owasp.about: The mapping sievant policy owasp prints, embedded in the binary.
